# ADR-3274: AWS tagging_compute: Instance metadata hop limit setting for ASG 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

IMDSv1 without hop limits enables SSRF key theft.

## Decision

Compute baselines SHALL set an instance metadata hop limit setting for ASG 2 (AWS-tagging_compute-2).

## Consequences

Require IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 for containers.
